profile.research_note:
Facility specific seeding pass 2026-09-02, batch 69 (Segra missing-address campaign): applied a combined two-building address, 3100 and 3101 International Airport Drive, Charlotte, sourced from a facility specific aggregator listing corroborated by this operators own site naming exactly two Charlotte facilities, since this registrys single generic Charlotte row could not be confirmed against only one of the two buildings.

[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] Segra is a fiber and data center services provider based in Charlotte, North Carolina. This specific facility level reading supplements an earlier operator level pass already on file for this operator, which found a corporate headquarters address, 11215 North Community House Road, explicitly not confirmed as tied to any specific data center facility. This operators own current site names two distinct Charlotte facilities, Charlotte One Data Center and Charlotte Two Data Center, separate from a third Kannapolis facility and the corporate headquarters. A facility specific aggregator listing independently corroborates this naming, giving Segra Charlotte 1 at 3100 International Airport Drive and Segra Charlotte 2 at 3101 International Airport Drive, both Charlotte 28208, essentially across the street from each other. Since this registry carries only one generic Charlotte row for this operator and this session could not confirm which of the two named buildings it represents, both addresses are applied together as the shared campus location rather than attributing the row to only one building. The separate Kannapolis facility is not represented by this row and is not applied here.
sources_tried: This operators own colocation and data centers page (named two distinct Charlotte facilities plus a separate Kannapolis site, no street addresses), and a facility specific aggregator listing naming both Charlotte buildings with addresses, applied together given this registry has only one row for the two adjacent buildings

reading.body:
SEGRA in Charlotte publishes no power capacity, compute density, or cooling specifications for this facility. The campus consists of two adjacent buildings at International Airport Drive, both named by the operator as separate Charlotte colocation data centers, but without published IT load or infrastructure detail this reading cannot assess their significance to AI scaling.

North Carolina has 19 mapped data center facilities and only 5 with published power capacity totaling 50 MW. This campus would rank sixth by published capacity if it had disclosed a figure, but since it has not, its position in the state's infrastructure cannot be determined.

Without specifications, this campus cannot be read as material to decisions about AI grid constraints in its region or beyond.
